updates.summary: NVIDIA now advertises up to 1.9x inference speedups from the latest DGX Spark software update, together with streamlined NemoClaw installation and updated open-model support.
reliability_changes: Improved unified-memory out-of-memory handling and user feedback under memory pressure.
NemoClaw supports bounded managed vLLM profiles for single DGX Spark systems.
NemoClaw includes an experimental managed vLLM path for two DGX Spark systems and supports attaching operator-managed llama.cpp servers.
updates.benchmark_caution: The headline up-to-1.9x figure is manufacturer-published and is not stored as a normalized model-specific benchmark because the product page does not provide one universal model/runtime/context configuration for that number.
